rounds.text: Boss Packaging Solutions Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a discounted cash flow analysis suggesting a value of Rs 153 per share against a market price of Rs 53 [E37]. This valuation gap is supported by a conservative balance sheet that is effectively debt-free, with borrowings reduced to a negligible Rs 0.03 Cr [E31, E32, E44]. The company demonstrates strong operational efficiency, evidenced by a cash conversion ratio of 2.25x, ensuring that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E28]. Furthermore, the stock trades at a P/E of 14.68x and an EV/EBITDA of 5.86x, both of which are substantially lower than their respective sector benchmarks of 21.23x and 11.89x [E6, E11]. While the company has shown consistent sales growth, reaching 31% over the trailing twelve months, the market has yet to fully price in this momentum [E16]. Conceded: the company pays no dividend [E4, E45], and free cash flow was negative at Rs -0.82 Cr in March 2026 [E30]. Despite these factors, the firm’s ability to maintain a ROCE of 15.05% against a sector benchmark of 13% highlights a superior ability to generate returns on capital [E10].
